## Privacy

This website does not use analytics, does not set cookies, and does not
embed third-party trackers. Fonts, styles and scripts are all served from
this site itself rather than from third-party services, so visiting this
site does not, on its own, send information about you to any company
other than the one hosting the site (see below).

**Hosting.** This site is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). As with any
web host, GitHub's servers necessarily process standard technical
information to deliver pages, for example your IP address and the page
requested, as part of ordinary web server operation. See
[GitHub's privacy statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement)
for details.

**Outbound links.** Some pages link to other websites, for example journals,
news articles or partner networks. Those sites have their own privacy
practices, which this notice does not cover.

If you have questions about this privacy notice, see [Contact](contact.qmd).
